method: Whole4files manually read; pinned Git byte comparison. No UI/commands executed.
findings: File-tree page stages9column visibility choices, animation/time display,1..8color selection and palette. Apply effect updates changed columns, resorts on animation toggle and notifies list-style; no filesystem rescan requested by this page.
Color count comes from bounded slider and is staged without separate explicit range validation in PrepareSettings; no forged native-control input test.
Cleanup page copies persistent list into local m_udc, edits/adds/removes/reorders locally, then stages one SetUserDefinedCleanups action with copied list. It does not execute configured commands.

PrepareSettings validates current refresh-policy selection0..2, normalizes empty current title and stores current dialog; does not validate every command string or every inactive item policy. Persisted legacy/inactive values require separate qualification.

Event handlers enforce no recursive operation without directory/drive applicability, force WaitForCompletion for recursion and reset refresh policy when wait disabled. Initialization displays loaded values without replaying all normalization handlers; no invariant guarantee for arbitrary persisted input.

Add count has no practical cap in this page and narrows vector size to int for selection; memory/count stress untested. Move validates destination and swaps local items, preserving persistent application until commit.
Command syntax, path placeholders and shell evaluation belong to previously reviewed runtime helper; local edit transaction does not imply safe immutable-file replacement.
limits: No UI apply/cancel, native-control manipulation, command syntax or filesystem action runtime test.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
